title: Sam Shares His Snack
text: At lunch, Sam sees that Lily forgot her snack. Lily's stomach growls, and she looks sad. Sam breaks his crackers in half without being asked. He hands half to Lily with a big smile. Lily says thank you, and the two friends eat together. Sam always looks for ways to help his classmates.
comprehension_hint_topics: what Sam's actions show about him
how Lily feels before Sam helps her
